name: witcher3-build-planner
description: Skill planner for The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt Remastered: skill trees, slots, mutagens, mutations and shareable build codes

paragraphs: Plan a character for The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt Remastered before you spend a single point in the game. The Remastered release reworked the skill trees, renamed skills, moved them and added new ones, so the planners made for earlier versions no longer match what the game shows. This one follows the game as it is now, version 5.00c, from the skill trees to the mutations, the potions and the witcher gear, and it fits a whole build into one link you can send to a friend or keep for later.
